children: Charles Schwab's third-quarter net revenues reached a record $7.2 billion, up 17% year-over-year, as growth in asset management fees and net interest income offset lower per-trade revenue. Asset management and administration fees rose 14% to $1.9 billion, reflecting increased client use of wealth and managed investing solutions. Net interest revenue climbed 14% to $3.5 billion as net interest margin expanded to 3.04%. GAAP earnings per share rose 29% to a record $1.62, while pre-tax profit margin reached 52.7%. The firm repurchased 4.7 million shares for $500 million during the quarter.
